title: "PPP Last Name Prediction"
author: "Weiran"
output: html_document

## Setup - Run in console
#install.packages('haven')
#install.packages('predictrace')

```{r setup_lastname_ppp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries (make sure to install these first manually in the Console)
options(timeout = 600)
repos <- c(CRAN = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/latest")

# Find project root by walking up until we find the Data directory
.dir <- getwd()
while (!dir.exists(file.path(.dir, "Data")) && .dir != dirname(.dir)) {
  .dir <- dirname(.dir)
}
parent_dir <- .dir

install.packages("remotes", repos = repos)
remotes::install_version("haven", version = "2.5.4", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
if (!requireNamespace("foreign", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("foreign", repos = repos)
remotes::install_version("predictrace", version = "2.0.1", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
```

```{r lastname_predict_ppp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- haven::read_dta(file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "lastname_interim_PPP.dta"))

results <- predictrace::predict_race(data$lastname, probability = FALSE, surname = TRUE)
names(results)[names(results) == "name"] <- "lastname"

results[results == ""] <- NA
haven::write_dta(results, file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "results_interim_lastname_PPP.dta"))
```
